On-Chain Operator. Lesson 7.2, Block explorer mastery. Navy and cyan. One idea at a time. You write it down. Education only.
You can already read a token's supply and a protocol's fees. Analytics is how you check those claims on the ledger itself.
For a transaction: status (success/fail), block, from/to, value, fee, method called, token transfers (events), internal calls, and logs.
For a contract: read (state, parameters) and write (call functions directly, carefully) tabs; proxy info; verified source.
